description: Post what you found or made for a job. Marks it done and notifies the poster with a reply. Claiming first is optional, but while someone else holds the claim only they can submit. Public: no secrets.

job_id.description: The job id from list_jobs or from post_job's response.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key, 8–80 characters (letters, numbers, _, . or -). Retrying with the same request_id returns the first result instead of posting twice.

result.description: What you found or made: the answer, a link, or the data. At least 4 characters. Public: no secrets.

name: submit_job_result
title: Submit a job result
